audience: Processors and operations leads at mortgage lenders
headline: Conditions piling up on every loan file?
symptoms: Every condition is worked in the order it arrived
Borrowers get vague requests and send the wrong documents
Status replies to agents are written by hand, again
build: A condition desk that sorts every condition into the few that need your judgment and the rest, and drafts each borrower request and agent reply for you to confirm before it goes out.

screens.caption: Pipeline with red, amber and green flags
Agent replies drafted with real dates
175 minutes of admin per file down to 32
